MedicalJobsAustralia.com     Make a meaningful difference with us 

We're looking for someone who wants to make the world a little better through small moments that leave big impacts. To build meaningful relationships and make a difference in the lives of others. 

As a Functional Analyst - SAP, you will play a critical role in supporting and enhancing UnitingCare's finance systems, ensuring the stability, performance and continuous improvement of our SAP solutions. Working closely with Finance and Digital & Technology teams, you'll help deliver system enhancements, solve complex business challenges and enable efficient financial operations across one of Queensland's largest not-for-profit organisations.

Please note, this position is a permanent role. Flexibility is important to us, and we know it is to you, too - this role supports hybrid working by agreement. 
 

Your part in our UnitingCare team: 

Provide functional support for SAP financial and billing systems, ensuring effective financial operations, reporting and month-end processing.

Investigate and resolve complex billing, pricing and system issues, including detailed root cause analysis.

Support payment and banking processes, billing configurations, health fund contracts and pricing arrangements.

Monitor and resolve system integration issues across SAP and connected enterprise platforms while maintaining data integrity.

Work with stakeholders to define business requirements and support the delivery of system enhancements and improvements.

Champion strong data governance practices, ensuring the accuracy, integrity and effective use of financial and billing data.

Contribute to projects, upgrades and continuous improvement initiatives that optimise business processes and user experience.
 

What makes a difference for us? 

Tertiary qualifications in Information Technology, Financial Software Applications or a related discipline.

Demonstrated experience as a Functional Analyst or Systems Accountant supporting SAP ECC with ABAP, in a complex environment

Strong knowledge of SAP finance and billing modules including Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, General Ledger, Assets and Projects.

Experience supporting billing, pricing, health fund contracts and claims processing environments.

Expertise in SAP configuration, pricing structures, tariffs and contract management.

Proven problem-solving skills with experience resolving complex system, payment and billing issues.

Experience with system integrations, interface monitoring and enterprise platforms.

Strong analytical thinking, stakeholder engagement and communication skills.

Experience supporting testing, system enhancements, reporting, audit compliance and data governance practices.

CA or CPA qualifications will be highly regarded.

Confidence to satisfy the relevant probity checks required by legislation or policy, including a Nationally Coordinated Police Check and Right to Work in Australia.

The opportunity to be part of the second-largest Queensland employer who has been leading by example for more than 100 years. Joining our team, you'll be welcomed as part of the UnitingCare family. INVENTORY CONCEPTS
Pymble, Sydney, NSW 2073

Full Time Contract Administrator
SALARY:  $87,500 per annum plus superannuation 

Position 
The Contract Administrator is responsible for the administration, performance monitoring, and commercial management of all client contracts and fixed-rate service agreements across the business. The role plays a critical part in ensuring contractual compliance, maintaining profitability, protecting contract margins and compliance, and delivering operational efficiencies throughout the supply chain and logistics network. 


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
Contract Administration and Commercial Management 
•	Administer and manage all client contracts and fixed-price service agreements to ensure compliance with contractual obligations and service level requirements. 
•	Monitor contract performance, profitability, and operational outcomes against agreed contractual terms. 
•	Develop, review, negotiate, and implement contract variations, renewals, extensions, and service agreements. 
•	Identify and implement initiatives to improve contract profitability and operational efficiency. 
•	Maintain accurate contract documentation, pricing schedules, and commercial records. 
Financial Analysis and Business Improvement 
•	Analyse operational, financial, and performance data to identify trends, risks, and opportunities for cost reduction and productivity improvements. 
•	Develop pricing models and costing structures for existing and prospective contracts. 
•	Prepare costing and pricing inputs for contract renewals, variations and client quotation responses. 
•	Conduct commercial analysis of contract performance to support contract negotiations, variations and renewals. 
•	Prepare forecasting data and performance reports to support future business planning. 
Client and Stakeholder Management 
•	Build and maintain strong relationships with existing and prospective clients. 
•	Act as a key point of contact for contractual matters and service-related issues. 
•	Ensure client expectations and contractual deliverables are clearly understood and consistently achieved. 
•	Support client retention initiatives and identify opportunities to expand service offerings within existing contracts. 
•	Participate in contract review meetings with clients, subcontractors and management. 
Supply Chain and Operational Coordination 
•	Work closely with logistics, warehouse, and inventory management teams to ensure contractual requirements are effectively delivered. 
•	Coordinate subcontractor performance to ensure service delivery standards, compliance requirements, and commercial objectives are achieved. 
•	Monitor operational performance against contractual KPIs and agreed service levels. 
•	Assist in the implementation of continuous improvement initiatives across supply chain operations.
Contract Compliance, Risk and Reporting 
•	Analyse risks associated with specific contract terms and advise management on appropriate mitigation. 
•	Monitor relevant legislative, award and regulatory changes affecting contracts and coordinate with management and external advisers as required. 
•	Interpret and explain contract requirements, terms and conditions to internal stakeholders, clients and subcontractors to support compliance. 
•	Maintain and improve contract-management systems and records, including the in-house platform, to support accurate and efficient contract administration. 
•	Assist in the preparation and negotiation of contract terms, renewals and variations with clients and subcontractors. 

SKILLS, KNOWLEDGE, AND EXPERIENCE 
•	Demonstrated experience in contract administration, commercial management, or supply chain contract management. 
•	Strong financial and commercial acumen with the ability to analyse costs, profitability, and operational performance. 
•	Experience within logistics, warehousing, inventory management, third-party logistics (3PL), or supply chain environments. 
•	Sound understanding of fixed-price service agreements, contract compliance, and service level management. 
•	Proven ability to manage multiple stakeholders and maintain strong client relationships. 
•	Experience in pricing analysis, contract negotiation, and the administration of contract variations and renewals. 
•	Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with advanced data interpretation capabilities. 
•	Excellent written and verbal communication skills. 
•	High-level computer literacy and proficiency in business systems, reporting tools, and data analysis software. 
•	Knowledge of warehouse operations, distribution centres, inventory control, container handling, and material handling equipment (MHE). 
•	Demonstrated understanding of Workplace Health and Safety (WHS) requirements within 
•	logistics and distribution environments. 
•	Relevant qualifications in Business, Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Operations 
•	Management, Information Technology, or a related discipline at AQF Associate Degree, Advanced Diploma or Diploma level or above. 
•	A demonstrable track record in WHS and its applications in fast paced and dynamic distribution facilities. 


Applications open on 24 July 2026 and close on 23 August 2026
Please send your CV to info@businessnest.com.au. Please include the job role title in your email.

Sip and Savor Creation Pty Ltd, trading as Fully Promoted Springfield, is seeking a full-time Sales and Marketing Manager to lead the sales and marketing function of its branded apparel, uniforms and promotional products business in Augustine Heights, Queensland.

About the business

Fully Promoted Springfield is a locally operated showroom and production business serving organisations across Greater Springfield, Ipswich and South-West Brisbane. The business supplies corporate uniforms, workwear, hi-vis apparel, teamwear and promotional merchandise, supported by in-house embroidery and digital printing, product consultation and branded ordering solutions.

About the role

The Sales and Marketing Manager will plan, direct and coordinate the business's sales and marketing activities. The role will be responsible for growing revenue, developing priority customer segments, strengthening repeat business and key accounts, and maintaining a strong market position for Fully Promoted Springfield's products and branding services.

Key responsibilities

• Develop and implement sales and marketing strategies for branded uniforms, workwear, promotional merchandise and decoration services.
• Set sales targets, customer acquisition priorities and service standards, and monitor performance against agreed objectives.
• Research customer needs, competitor activity and market opportunities across Greater Springfield, Ipswich and surrounding business communities.
• Plan and direct integrated campaigns across digital, local-area, relationship and in-store marketing channels.
• Develop sector-specific sales initiatives for trades, construction, professional services, healthcare, education, hospitality, retail, sporting clubs and community organisations.
• Build and manage key business accounts, recurring uniform programs and customer retention strategies.
• Direct product positioning, promotional offers and go-to-market activity across apparel, workwear, event products and corporate merchandise.
• Coordinate sales and marketing activity with the owners, product specialists and production team so campaigns reflect stock availability, decoration capacity, lead times and quality standards.
• Oversee the sales pipeline, quotations, proposals, account follow-up and performance reporting, using customer and order data to improve conversion and repeat purchasing.
• Prepare sales forecasts, marketing budgets and management reports, and recommend adjustments to strategy, channel mix and resource allocation.
• Maintain consistent brand presentation and strengthen the business's reputation through customer engagement, partnerships and local business networks.
• Guide sales and marketing staff in campaign execution, customer relationship management and achievement of performance targets.

Qualifications and experience

• A bachelor degree in a relevant field is mandatory; a higher qualification is preferred.
• Demonstrated experience planning and implementing sales and marketing strategies aligned with business objectives.
• Experience developing client, partner and stakeholder relationships and identifying new business opportunities.
• Ability to research customer needs, competitor activity and market trends and translate findings into practical growth initiatives.
• Experience negotiating commercial terms, managing key accounts and supporting customer retention.
• Experience preparing proposals, presentations and sales pitches for business customers and stakeholders.
• Ability to monitor sales and marketing performance, prepare forecasts and management reports, and recommend improvements.
• Strong communication, negotiation, analytical and stakeholder-management skills.
• Ability to collaborate effectively with sales, marketing, product and operational teams in a results-focused environment.

This is a permanent, full-time and on-site position based at Fully Promoted Springfield in Augustine Heights, Queensland.

Salary: $80,000 per annum plus statutory superannuation.

To apply, submit your resume and cover letter through this advertisement.

This position is only open to Australian citizens and permanent residency visa holders.

result.description:
General Clerk

Location: Derby, Western Australia (West Kimberley)
Employment Type: Full-time, Ongoing (38 hours per week)

Salary: $69,000 – $72,000 per annum plus superannuation, with the final salary determined by qualifications and relevant experience.

About Us

Coral Coast Distributors (Cairns) Pty Ltd is a privately owned retail and distribution business servicing regional and remote communities throughout the Kimberley region of Western Australia.

Our operations support retail stores and distribution activities that provide household goods and everyday essentials to regional communities. We are committed to delivering excellent customer service while maintaining efficient and compliant business operations.

The Role

We are seeking a motivated and organised General Clerk to provide administrative and clerical support to our Derby operations.

This full-time position is responsible for a broad range of office administration duties and provides support to management and operational teams across the business. The successful applicant will be highly organised, accurate and capable of managing multiple priorities within a busy office environment.

Australian citizens and permanent residents are encouraged to apply.

Key Responsibilities
Perform a broad range of administrative and clerical duties.
Maintain accurate records, filing systems and business documentation.
Enter and maintain data within internal business systems.
Prepare correspondence, reports and routine business documents.
Assist with invoicing, purchase orders and general office administration.
Support payroll processing, timesheet administration and employee records.
Respond to telephone, email and general office enquiries.
Maintain supplier, customer and inventory records.
Schedule meetings, appointments and other administrative activities as required.
Use Microsoft Office and internal business systems to support daily operations.
Provide administrative support to managers and operational staff.
Skills and Experience
Previous experience in an administrative, clerical or office support role.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
High level of accuracy and attention to detail.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office, including Word, Excel and Outlook.
Strong organisational and time-management skills.
Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a team.
Ability to maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive information appropriately.
Ability to communicate effectively with colleagues, customers and suppliers.
Commitment to working respectfully with people from diverse cultural backgrounds.
Willingness to live and work in Derby, a regional location in the West Kimberley.
Desirable
Certificate III or IV in Business Administration or a related qualification.
Experience working in regional or remote business operations.
Experience using accounting, payroll or inventory management software.
Pre-Employment Requirements
National Police Check (acceptable outcome).
Applicants must have the right to work in Australia.
How to Apply

Please submit your resume together with a brief cover letter outlining your relevant experience and suitability for the role.

Only shortlisted applicants will be contacted.

Business Development Manager | Financial Services 
  Drive growth. Build relationships. Make a genuine impact.  
 Are you a driven Business Development professional who thrives on building relationships, creating new opportunities, and delivering exceptional customer outcomes? 
 Hoban Recruitment is partnering with a well-established and growing organisation within the financial services sector to recruit an experienced Business Development Manager. This is an exciting opportunity to join a business with ambitious growth plans, where you'll have the autonomy to develop new business, nurture referral networks, and play a key role in expanding market presence across Melbourne. 
 If you're passionate about sales, relationship management and helping clients achieve their financial goals, we'd love to hear from you. 
 About the Role 
 Reporting to senior leadership, you'll be responsible for identifying and converting new business opportunities while developing long-term relationships with referral partners and clients. 
 This is a hybrid role offering a combination of office-based work, client meetings and remote flexibility, with regular travel throughout Melbourne and surrounding regions. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 
 
 Identify, pursue and convert new business opportunities to achieve growth targets 
 
 
 Build and manage a healthy pipeline of qualified prospects 
 
 
 Develop strong referral partnerships with mortgage brokers, real estate agents, accountants and financial advisers 
 
 
 Conduct client meetings to understand lending requirements and deliver tailored solutions 
 
 
 Achieve monthly and quarterly sales targets and performance objectives 
 
 
 Represent the business at networking events, industry functions and community engagements 
 
 
 Maintain strong relationships with existing clients to encourage repeat business and referrals 
 
 
 Monitor market trends and competitor activity to identify new growth opportunities 
 
 
 Provide regular reporting on pipeline activity, sales performance and conversion metrics 
 
 
 Collaborate with internal lending, credit and customer service teams to ensure an exceptional client experience 
 
 
 About You 
 To be successful in this role, you'll bring: 
 
 
 Proven experience in Business Development, Sales, Mortgage Broking, Lending or Financial Services 
 
 
 Strong understanding of home loans, refinancing, lending or related financial products 
 
 
 Demonstrated success in developing new business and achieving sales targets 
 
 
 Exceptional relationship-building, networking and stakeholder management skills 
 
 
 Excellent communication, negotiation and presentation abilities 
 
 
 A proactive, self-motivated approach with the ability to work autonomously 
 
 
 Strong commercial acumen and a customer-first mindset 
 
 
 Excellent organisational and time management skills 
 
 
 What's on Offer 
 
 
 Competitive salary package with performance incentives 
 
 
 Hybrid working model offering flexibility 
 
 
 Opportunity to join a growing organisation with ambitious expansion plans 
 
 
 Supportive leadership and collaborative team environment 
 
 
 Genuine career progression opportunities 
 
 
 Autonomy to build your own client portfolio and referral network 
 
 
 A role where your contribution will have a direct impact on business growth 
 
 
 Why Apply? 
 This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced Business Development professional looking to take the next step in their career with a growing organisation that values relationships, innovation and customer success. 
 If you're motivated by achieving results, developing lasting partnerships and working in a dynamic environment, we'd love to hear from you. 
   

 At HOBAN we encourage applications from people with disability, people from diverse cultural and linguistic backgrounds, people of all genders, LGBTI people, and Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander people. 
 We provide reasonable adjustments; including alternate formats to the recruitment process for individuals with disability. If you require an adjustment to be made during the recruitment process, please email our Adjustments Coordinator at  adjustments@hoban.com.au  or visit  hoban.com.au/adjustments  for additional contact details.  Please  click here  to apply.

Trading under Publicis Communications Australia
Location: Sydney or Melbourne or Brisbane
 
Account Director (Also known as Business Director)

The purpose of the Account Director role is to manage and take major responsibility and accountability for all aspects of the creative agency’s business in partnership with the client. 
The Account Director manages the workflow, operational and quality processes within the team and across other agency departments, ensuring a high level of effective creative advertising output. The Account Director leads and supports more junior account management team members, maintains a collaborative and productive relationship with strategy, creative & production teams plus establisheds great client relationships at all levels. The Account Director will continually develop a 3-tiered understanding of the client’s business, the industry and the economic influences on the business - Identifying opportunities to grow client business. They will demonstrate Full management of financials – budget control and forecasting, along with meeting growth targets for the accounts through proactive initiatives
Salary: $90k - $105k package


Account Director (Also known as Business Director)

The purpose of the Account Director role is to manage and take major responsibility and accountability for all aspects of the creative agency’s business in partnership with the client. 

The Account Director manages the workflow, operational and quality processes within the team and across other agency departments, ensuring a high level of effective creative advertising output. The Account Director leads and supports more junior account management team members, maintains a collaborative and productive relationship with strategy, creative & production teams plus established great client relationships at all levels. The Account Director will continually develop a 3-tiered understanding of the client’s business, the industry, and the economic influences on the business -Identifying opportunities to grow client business. They will demonstrate Full management of financials –budget control and forecasting, along with meeting growth targets for the accounts through proactive initiatives.

Salary – Over threshold


 
Senior Account Director (Also known as Senior Business Director)

The Senior Account Director is tasked with leading and directing a client portfolio and is accountable for all aspects of the creative agency’s business in relation to their clients.  They develop strong client relationships and lead strategic and creative recommendations across their client portfolio. The role includes the management of a broad agency team and oversight of financial and operational aspects of the account. The Senior Account Director strategically manages the agency-client relationship and is able to independently articulate a clear and actionable strategy that meets objectives. The Senior Account Director seeks out opportunities for generating revenue, developing relationships, winning new business. They will lead new business pitches as requested.  The Senior Account Director has very strong creative evaluation skills and is able to judge when creative is on strategy or not, and is able to work with the creatives to strengthen ideas.  The Senior Account Director possesses a thorough understanding of the production & agency process - Is able to support and explain production estimates and schedules for broadcast/online/print/collateral/etc. and internal agency processes. The Senior Account Director Is able to inspire people at all levels to achieve peak performance, plus career manages and supports direct team by being a mentor and helping them set and achieve their career KPI’s.
Salary – Over threshold

Group Account Director (Also known as Group Business Director)

The Group Account Director is responsible for developing client relationships and leading strategic recommendations across a portfolio of creative advertising accounts. This role is one of leadership and example, inspiring and coaching your team to provide the best possible service to our clients. It plays a senior defining role in developing the Agency’s performance and culture.
The Group Account Director develops and cultivates trusting relationships with client senior management and shows market foresight to effectively anticipate threats and opportunities in your clients’ business. The Group Account Director manages effective communication ideas that drive top line growth and a competitive advantage on clients’ business.  The Group Account Director possesses a thorough understanding of the production & agency process - Is able to support and explain production estimates and schedules for broadcast/online/print/collateral/etc. and internal agency processes. The Group Account Director assumes overall accountability for the management/direction of all activities on your clients. The Group Account Director is responsible for growth and profitability of account portfolio, attaining annual revenue and margin targets, and leads new business efforts working in conjunction with senior management. The Group Account Director is able to inspire people at all levels to achieve peak performance, plus career manages and supports direct team by being a mentor and helping them set and achieve their career KPI’s.

Salary – Over threshold
 
Integrated Lead (also known as Client Partner, Business Director, Group Account Director, Group Business Director)

The Integrated Lead is our key Client Service lead, partnering with our local client team to drive business strategy, creative, content, insights, data and production across a portfolio of our client’s brands. The Integrated Lead will act as a trusted, agency business leader and the client’s business partner, responsible for ensuring that all the right agency capabilities are engaged, at the right time.  The role will lead an Integrated Agency Team, ensuring maximum connectivity, elevating the strategic thinking, driving breakthrough work, and delivering value.  
Role Responsibilities:
·	Lead and partner with our new clients to build rapport and understanding of their business and personal needs
·	Lead and develop complex B2B/HCP healthcare campaigns, across data, strategy, creative and production 
·	Manage teams of individuals from our matrix structure to deliver client requirements on time and on budget
·	Playing a leadership role across our local team of writers, other accounts service, studio, creatives and third parties.
·	Lead and collaborate with the medical writing team and relevant health professionals, to ensure all communications are relevant to the target audience, are of the highest quality and are in line with client briefs.
·	Lead and engage with potential clients, vendors and suppliers (both marketing and medical staff) when required 
·	Overall financial responsibility for all projects

Salary – Over threshold

All of the above roles require a relevant tertiary qualification or a minimum of 5 years of relevant experience in lieu of qualification.

Roles could also be available in Sydney, Melbourne, Brisbane

result.description:
Ashley Furniture is seeking an experienced Retail and Service Manager to lead their showroom in Griffith, NSW.

JOB DESCRIPTION:

Reports to: Director and Business Owner

Supervises: Store Managers, Assistant Managers, Sales Staff, Customer Service Staff, Administrative Staff, Warehouse Personnel and other operational employees as required.

Position Summary:
The Retail and Service Manager is responsible for planning, organising, directing, controlling and coordinating the operations of retail and service establishments to ensure the achievement of business objectives, profitability targets and customer service standards. The role oversees staff management, financial performance, inventory control, sales growth, customer engagement, operational compliance and
continuous business improvement.

Key Duties and Responsibilities

Business Operations Management
• Plan, organise, direct and coordinate the day-to-day operations of retail and service establishments.
• Develop and implement operational strategies, policies and procedures to achieve organisational objectives.
• Monitor business performance and implement initiatives to improve efficiency, productivity and profitability.
• Ensure compliance with company policies, industry regulations and workplace health and safety requirements.
• Coordinate business activities to ensure effective service delivery and operational continuity. 

Sales and Customer Service Management
• Develop and implement sales strategies to achieve revenue and profitability targets.
• Monitor sales performance and key performance indicators and take corrective action where required.
• Establish and maintain high standards of customer service and customer satisfaction.
• Manage customer enquiries, complaints and escalated issues in a professional and timely manner.
• Develop customer engagement and retention initiatives to strengthen customer relationships and business growth.

 Staff Leadership and Human Resource Management
• Recruit, train, supervise and develop employees to meet operational and customer service requirements.
• Allocate work responsibilities and manage staff rosters and resource requirements.
• Conduct performance reviews and provide coaching, mentoring and professional development opportunities.
• Foster a positive workplace culture focused on teamwork, accountability and customer service excellence.
• Ensure compliance with employment legislation, workplace policies and performance management procedures. 

Financial Management
• Prepare and manage operational budgets and expenditure forecasts.
• Monitor revenue, expenses and profitability to achieve financial objectives.
• Analyse financial reports and operational data to support informed business decisions.
• Authorise expenditure and ensure effective cost control measures are implemented.
• Prepare management reports relating to sales, staffing, inventory and business performance. 

Inventory and Supply Chain Management
• Oversee inventory planning, purchasing, stock control and stock replenishment activities.
• Monitor stock levels and coordinate procurement activities to maintain product availability.
• Manage supplier relationships and negotiate purchasing arrangements where required.
• Ensure accurate inventory records and stock management processes are maintained.
• Coordinate receiving, storage and distribution activities to support efficient business operations. 

Marketing and Business Development
• Coordinate promotional campaigns, merchandising activities and marketing initiatives.
• Identify opportunities to increase sales, improve customer engagement and expand business performance.
• Analyse market trends, customer preferences and competitor activities to support strategic planning.
• Participate in business development activities to strengthen market presence and customer growth. 

Compliance and Quality Assurance
• Ensure compliance with relevant legislation, industry regulations and workplace standards.
• Implement workplace health and safety policies and procedures.
• Monitor service standards and operational quality to ensure customer expectationsare consistently met.
• Conduct regular reviews of operational processes and implement continuous improvement initiatives.
• Maintain accurate business records, reports and operational documentation. 

Skills and Competencies
• Strong leadership and people management skills.
• Excellent customer service and relationship management abilities.
• Sound financial management and budgeting skills.
• Strong organisational and operational planning capabilities.
• Effective communication, negotiation and problem-solving skills.
• Ability to analyse business performance and implement improvement strategies.
• Strong inventory, procurement and supplier management experience. 


Qualifications
· Certificate, Diploma, or higher qualification in Retail, Business, Management, or a related field (preferred).

Salary range is $75,000-$95,000pa commensurate with experience

Full-time Position available

Application opens on 20th of July 2026 and closes on 20th of August 2026

If you are interested in this role APPLY now. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted
